rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a burning stick or hand-held torch.

example.english: It got dark, so we carried a torch into the cave.
example.traditional: 天黑喇，我哋拎住火把行入個山洞。
example.jyutping: tin1 hak1 laa3 ngo5 dei6 ling1 zyu6 fo2 baa2 haang4 jap6 go3 saan1 dung6

rows.note: Use this more formal word especially for a ceremonial or Olympic torch.

example.english: The athlete raised the Olympic torch at the opening ceremony.
example.traditional: 運動員喺開幕典禮上高舉火炬。
example.jyutping: wan6 dung6 jyun4 hai2 hoi1 mok6 din2 lai5 soeng6 gou1 geoi2 fo2 geoi6
